Dragon Tales - Dragon Adventures.name: Dragon Tales: Dragon Adventures
Dragon Tales - Dragon Adventures.summary: Wish on Dragon Scale and get whisked away to Dragon Land. Then choose your adventure from five different fun-filled stories. While searching for Dragon Berry cupcakes, gems, and musical Notes you will travel to magical places like Puzzlewood in the Crystal Caves!

Knit-Wit.name: Knit-Wit
Knit-Wit.summary: Knit-Wit is a push block puzzle game in the style of Nintendo's Game Boy Color. Puzzle your way through fifteen levels as you find enough wool to knit each of your family members a warm jumper and stave off the winter chills.
